status_note: Approved by Roc 2026-08-05 with an amendment: the component is an existing flame (`item_flame`), since the cast moves a flame that already exists and therefore spends it.
learn_source: Watch the priest at the Festival Grounds dip a flame from the rite-fire and send it lantern to lantern up the Lantern Arch — the Arch's lanterns hang past any taper's reach, and every cast spends the flame it sends
confirm_action: Cast it yourself once, giving up a flame of your own to a prepared wick
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the sent flame leaps far and runs many wicks before it is spent; at baseline it crosses only to the nearest prepared wick and a fresh flame must be found to cast again. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: State-dependent: wick dressed for the rite, the sent flame takes and burns steady; wick bare, the flame touches metal and dies — the cast's flame is spent either way
State-dependent: wicks dressed for the rite, the one sent flame runs lantern to lantern along the whole span in one pass; wicks undressed, it dies at the first bare one
The sent flame lands in the laid kindling and catches there
no_effect — the flame lands on the water and goes out; nothing catches, and the cast's flame is gone
No physical effect — no flame leaps to a living body; the sent flame falls short and gutters out on the ground
receivers.reaction_kind: head-tilt tracking the flame's arc, backs off a step from where it lands

receivers.physical_outcome: No physical effect — the sent flame gutters out short of her
receivers.reaction_kind: steps back and watches where the flame comes to rest
